name: Reality shop – 3D for Elementor and WooCommerce
author: kouroshweb

sections.description:
Reality shop is a free 3D wordpress plugin for Elementor and WooCommerce fully compatible, Low weigh and high performance setting.AR and try-on supported on premium.

Key Features:
– Upload and manage GLB files in WordPress.
– Assign a GLB file shortcode to WooCommerce products.
– Display GLB models in Elementor using a custom widget.
– Copy and manage GLB file shortcodes easily from the admin panel.
– Automatically remove associated shortcodes from products when deleting a file.

License

https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. Upload it to your WordPress site via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to Reality Shop 3D in the WordPress admin menu to manage your GLB files.
  5. Use shortcodes or Elementor widgets to display 3D models.
sections.faq:
How do I upload a GLB file?

Go to Reality Shop 3D in your WordPress dashboard, click “Upload File,” and select your GLB model.

How do I add a 3D model to a WooCommerce product?

In the product edit page, find the Reality Shop 3D Shortcode metabox and paste the generated shortcode.

What happens when I delete a GLB file?

If a GLB file is deleted from the plugin’s admin panel, all associated product shortcodes will be removed.

Does this plugin support Elementor?

Yes! You can use the 3D GLB Viewer widget in Elementor to display models.
